Co-administration of adagrasib and foscarnet may increase the effects of each other by prolonging the QTc interval. This combination should be avoided, or alternative drugs should be used. Both drugs can prolong the QTc interval, increasing the risk of torsades de pointes, other serious arrhythmias, and sudden death. If co-administration is unavoidable, more frequent monitoring is recommended. 3. Alfuzosin and foscarnet both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use alternative drugs. 4.
